relations.description: Service request procedure is guarded by the condition that network does not accept the request.
When service request is not accepted, UE informs upper layers of procedure failure.
When abnormal case a) occurs, UE informs upper layers of emergency services fallback failure.
When other abnormal cases occur, UE may attempt to select E-UTRA cell.
After selecting suitable E-UTRA cell, UE proceeds with EMM or 5GMM procedures.
If UE in single-registration mode changes to S1 mode, it disables N1 mode capability.
